steps: lua:__vc_windows = {} local wm = xyd.WindowManager.get() local open = wm.openWindow wm.openWindow = function(self, name, ...) __vc_windows[name] = (__vc_windows[name] or 0) + 1 return open(self, name, ...) end

lua:__vc_ab = {} for _, key in ipairs({'mtspy', 'n7gso'}) do xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.GET_PLAYER_GROUP_BY_KEY, {unique_key = key}, function(code, group) __vc_ab[key] = tostring(code) .. ':' .. tostring(group) end) end

lua:local player = xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) player:setPlayerGuideFunction({guide_function_id = 18}) local story = xyd.StoryData.get() xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.SAVE_STORY, {story_id = story:getStoryID(), story_state = story:getStoryState(), guide_id = story:getGuideID() + 0.1}, function(code) __vc_story = code end)
lua:if __vc_ab.mtspy ~= tostring(xyd.error.OK) .. ':A' or __vc_ab.n7gso ~= tostring(xyd.error.OK) .. ':B' then error('vc-abtest-' .. tostring(__vc_ab.mtspy) .. '-' .. tostring(__vc_ab.n7gso)) end

lua:local list = xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER).guideFuncList if list['18'] ~= 1 then error('vc-guide-function-' .. tostring(list['18'])) end if __vc_story ~= xyd.error.OK then error('vc-fractional-guide-' .. tostring(__vc_story)) end

lua:local cards = {} local function walk(node) if not node:isVisible() then return end if node:getName() == 'layout' then table.insert(cards, node) return end for _, child in ipairs(node:getChildren()) do walk(child) end end walk(xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('battle_select_team'):nodeByName('list_layer')) for _, card in ipairs(cards) do local box = card:getCascadeBoundingBox() __vc.tap(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2) end
